claims.quote: `@lionlang/ui` adds a themeable default stylesheet (`@lionlang/ui/styles.css`) driven by `--lion-ui-*` CSS variables with a built-in `light` preset, per-slot `classes` / `unstyled` and per-node `className` overrides in `renderUi()`, and replaces native `<select>` with a custom accessible dropdown menu.

Separates landing-page copy from live `@lionlang/ui` output on `lionlang.dev` by moving example intros onto the page background and framing evaluated output inside a labeled dot-grid `Lion output` viewport.
